headline: Caterpillar Stock Slumps as Weakness Outside Data Centers Weighs
summary: Caterpillar stock experienced its largest decline in seven years as weak results across general industrial divisions offset growth in its data center equipment line, pressuring the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
why: Caterpillar is a global heavy equipment manufacturer viewed as a barometer for industrial manufacturing, construction, and capital expenditure.

impacts.name: Caterpillar
impacts.why: Disappointing segment results raise concerns over broader industrial demand slowdown.

why_moved: Widespread weakness outside the niche data center unit triggered heavy selling in industrial sector equities.
